Setting up of rooftop helipads
*261. SHRI DHARAM PAL
SABHARWAL:
SHRI N.R. GOVINDA-
RAJAR:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is mandatory to seek
approval of Director General, Civil Aviation
(DGCA) for construction of rooftop
helipads;
(b) if so, the details of guidelines in this
regard;
(c) the names of individuals/companies
who have been given permission to
construct rooftop helipads in Mumbai and
Delhi; and
(d) the number of applications pending,
with names of corporate houses/
individuals?

SEKAR REDDY: W ill the Minister of
FINANCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government is increasing
the credit flow from commercial banks to
the Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
(MSMEs);

last three years, State-wise;
(c) whether Government has any
proposal to give special packages to each
State in this regard, especially in Andhra
Pradesh;
(d) if so, the details thereof;
(e) the present position thereof; and
(f) if not, the reasons therefor?
Supply of LPG in the Country
†*263. SHRI SATYAVRAT
CHATURVEDI:
SHRI MOTILAL VORA:
Will the Minister of PETROLEUM
AND NATURAL GAS be pleased to
state:
(a) the names of those States in the
country, in respect of which Government
is aware of shortage of LPG therein;
(b) the quantum of LPG being allocated
in the country, State-wise; and

85
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
(c) whether allocation of LPG for those
States would be enhanced in the  current
year, where such allocation is not done as
per their requirement?

RASHTRAPAL:  Wi ll the Minister of
CIVIL AVIATION be pleased to state:
(a) whether any proposal for

Foreign Financial Institutions in
stock markets

SINGH MAJITHA:
DR. MURLI MANOHAR
JOSHI:
Will the Minister of FINANCE be

(a) whether it is a fact that after
imposition of a ban on ‘Participatory Notes’

Government, there has been an increase in
the number of Foreign Financial Institutions

accounts associated therewith has also
increased; and
(c) if so, the respective number of
Foreign Financial Institutions and accounts
associated therewith in the middle of
November, 2007?
Insurance for income-tax payer
†*266. SHRI BANWARI LAL

be introduced; and
(c) if not, the reasons therefor?

FINANCE be pleased to state:

completed and the number of projects

driving up costs substantially;

infrastructure projects in sectors like
Roads, Power, Petroleum, Coal, Aviation,
Steel and Urban Development are running
behind schedule and driving up costs

any steps for their timely completion; and
(e) if so, the details thereof?
Task Force for interlinking of rivers
†*268. SHRI KRISHAN LAL
BALMIKI:
SHRI KALRAJ MISHRA:
Will the Minister of WATER
RESOURCES be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the Task

86

(b) if so, the reasons therefor; and
(c) the suggestions of the Task Force in
this regard?
Participation of private sector in
training of pilots
*269. SHRI KALRAJ MISHRA:
SHRI SANTOSH
BAGRODIA:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION
be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Ministry has made an
assessment of prospective need for
commercial pilots in civil aviation sector in
the country;
(b) if so, whether the country has world
class training institutes to meet the
prospective requirement of trained
commercial pilots;
(c) the current strength of the existing
civil aviation academies/campuses in the
country;
(d) whether Government propose to
enhance the existing strength of aviation
academies/campuses; and

expansion and whether Government is
open to participation by the private
operators?
Survey on functioning of banks in
villages
†*270. SHRI MOTILAL VORA:
SHRI SATYAVRAT
CHATURVEDI:
Will the Minister of FINANCE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether attention of Government
has been drawn towards a survey by Invest
India Market Solutions Dataworks
regarding functioning of banks in villages
where only 38 per cent of labourers have
bank accounts;
(b) whether out of 22.7 crore village
labourers only 8.61 crore have accounts in
banks;
(c) the reasons for banks being situated
far off from villages and whether the main
reason for this is indifference of Bank
Officers; and
(d) what efforts are being made by
Government for increasing bank
transactions in villages?
Shopping tourism in India
*271. MS. PRAMILA BOHIDAR:
SHRI B.J. PANDA:
Will the Minister of TOURISM be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is proposed to launch
shopping tourism in the country to woo
foreign tourists in a Public Private
Partnership mode;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether Bhubaneswar in Orissa is
also one of the places where this project
would be launched;
(d) if so, the details thereof; and
(e) what are the details of other
measures that are proposed to be worked
out to boost tourism in Orissa to improve
the economy of this region?
Smuggling of antique statues of Gods
*272. SHRIMATI HEMA MALINI:
Will the Minister of CULTURE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that priceless
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

87
treasures like antique statues of Gods and
Goddesses, invaluable sculpture are being
regularly smuggled abroad under the garb
of replicas from villages of Rajasthan,
Orissa, Chhattisgarh, Madhya  Pradesh,
Uttarakhand and Tamil Nadu;
(b) if so, the number of such antiques
smuggled so far, State-wise;
(c) whether Government is taking action
to forthwith stop such undesirable
smuggling; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Heritage Status to Majuli island in
Assam
*273. KUMAR DEEPAK DAS:  Will
the Minister of CULTURE  be pleased to
state:
(a) whether the Archaeological Survey
of India and the State Government of
Assam have fulfilled all requirements
including submission of additional
information towards fulfilling the conditions
of UNESCO concerning the World Heritage
Status of Majuli island;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) if not, whether these are likely to be
submitted;
(d) the reason for inordinate delay to
compile this information;
(e) whether Government would
renominate to put Majuli in the World
Heritage Map in 2008; and
(f) if so, the details thereof?
Appointment of LPG dealers in Uttar
Pradesh
*274. SHRI KAMAL AKHTAR:  Will
the Minister of PETROLEUM AND
NATURAL GAS be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government had published
any advertisement last month for the
appointment of LPG dealers in Uttar
Pradesh;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the districts in Uttar Pradesh for
which no advertisement was published; and
(d) the reasons for not appointing any
LPG dealers in these districts where
common man faces hardships in getting
LPG cylinders?
Oil exploration in Mahanadi Basin
*275. SHRI BHAGIRATHI MAJHI:
Will the Minister of PETROLEUM AND
NATURAL GAS be pleased to state:
(a) the details of the running projects
and pending proposals for oil and natural
gas exploration in Orissa;
(b) whether there has been a proposal
for setting up oil exploration on the bank
of Mahanadi river;
(c) if so, the details thereof; and
(d) if not, the reasons therefor?
India Infrastructure Development
Fund
*276. SHRIMATI PREMA
CARIAPPA:
SHRIMATI SHOBHANA
BHARTIA:
Will the Minister of FINANCE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Centre has promised to
provide a corpus of Rs. 100 crore, named
as India Infrastructure Development Fund,
to provide up to 75 per cent  of the
development costs of a project till the
bidding stage, to assist the States in
preparing Public-Private Partnership
projects for the infrastructure sector;

88
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
(b) whether this proposal was a part of
the Budget for 2007-08 and the Cabinet
Committee on Economic Affairs has
already given its approval; and
(c) if so, what are these projects in the
States for which Government has allocated
funds so far?
Opening of Pilot Training Institutes
†*277. SHRI DATTA MEGHE:  Will
the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has taken any
steps to meet the shortage of pilots in Civil
Aviation Sector in the country and has also
taken decision to open new training
institutes;
(b) if so, the location of these training
institutes to be opened and the number of
pilots to be trained in these institutes every
year;
(c) whether Government has formulated
any long term scheme keeping in view the
demand of pilots in Civil Aviation Sector in
the country; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Functioning of Dabolim airport
*278. SHRI SHANT ARAM
LAXMAN NAIK:  Will the Minister of
CIVIL AVIATION be pleased to state:
(a) whether Dabolim airport in Goa has
been made open for 24 hours for civilian
operations;
(b) the number of applications, if any,
received by Government from airlines
services for their operations between 6 p.m.
to 6 a.m; and
(c) what are the details thereof?
Sex tourism in India
*279. SHRI SHAHID SIDDIQUI: Will
the Minister of TOURISM be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government is aware of
reports of increase in sex tourism in India;
(b) whether it is a fact that India is
becoming international sex tourism
destination and place of attraction for
paedophiles;
(c) if so, what action is being taken to
control and eliminate sex tourism; and
(d) whether the Ministry has formed
some special groups to focus and fight
growing sex tourism in States like Goa,
Kerala, Karnataka, Maharashtra and Delhi?
Increase in foreign debt of the country
†*280. SHRI RAVI SHANKAR
PRASAD:
SHRI RAM JETHMALANI:
Will the Minister of FINANCE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the amount
of foreign debt on the country is increasing
constantly;
(b) if so, the percentage of increase in
the amount of foreign debt for the period
2004-05 to 2006-07; and
(c) the amount of interest paid on the
foreign debt during the above said period,
year-wise?
